sense: the dark part of the day

pins.definition: The dark part of the day, from after sunset until sunrise, including the late evening.
The dark period between evening and morning when most people sleep.
The dark part of the 24-hour day, between evening and morning.

situation: A woman alone in her bedroom wakes up in total darkness and turns on her bedside lamp.
subject: the deep darkness outside
brief: A woman in a quiet bedroom switches on a single brass bedside lamp, and its warm golden cone of light stops abruptly at the windowpane. Beyond the glass, the outside world is a vast, heavy, impenetrable blackness with only the faint, distant pinprick of a single star.
